text:
anna.k: Heads-up — recompute-v3 for EU hourly aggregates crashed mid-run. Airflow task shows IntegrityError / UniqueViolation on hourly_agg_pkey. Anyone available to triage?

mike.h: I can pick this up. Are the errors from the DAG logs or the worker pod?

anna.k: Airflow task logs. Stacktrace points to upsert_hourly_aggregates. Example: psycopg2.errors.UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "hourly_agg_pkey"

priya.r: Did we run with dedupe enabled? We merged the dedupe flag last sprint but DAG default is still off.

anna.k: This run used defaults (dedupe=false). DAG: telemetry_recompute_v3, run id 2026-03-25T02:15:00, region=EU only.

josh.l: If dedupe exists rerunning with dedupe=true seems reasonable. Need to verify upsert semantics are idempotent — our intended behavior is last_write_wins.

marta: Quick ops note: a full EU backfill will drive heavy IO on reporting DB. We should canary a single shard (eu-west-1) and a 24h window first.

mike.h: Proposed steps:
1) dry-run upserts on a small timeslice
2) compare counts/checksums to baseline
3) if OK, schedule full rerun in maintenance window (02:00-06:00 UTC) with throttling

anna.k: How do we run the dry-run? Worker has a flag? I recall --dry-run.

josh.l: Worker supports --dry-run and --dedupe-window (seconds). Example command:
```
kubectl exec -it job-runner -- /srv/worker/run_recompute --shard=eu --start=2026-03-23T00:00 --end=2026-03-24T00:00 --dry-run --dedupe-window=3600
```

priya.r: Also run this SQL to measure candidate duplicate keys so we know the scope before writes:
```
SELECT hour, COUNT(*) as rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (customer_id, metric)) as distinct_keys
FROM hourly_agg
WHERE region='eu' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-23' AND '2026-03-24'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;
```

marta: If we can't get the full maintenance slot, set DAG max_active_tasks=4 and throttle reads to reporting DB. Telemetry-recompute is IO heavy.

anna.k: Can someone run the dry-run now and paste the sample output? Need to see predicted overwrites and checksum delta.

mike.h: Kicking off dry-run on eu-west shard. ETA ~3m. @analytics-bot pls post logs when ready.

deploy-bot: airflow task started: telemetry_recompute_v3.run_recompute[run_2026-03-25] on worker cluster-7 — logs: https://airflow.internal/logs/telemetry_recompute_v3/2026-03-25

analytics-bot: dry-run result: processed 3600 buckets, predicted upserts=1100, predicted overwrites=850, no fatal errors. Snippet:
```
INFO processed 3600 buckets
INFO predicted overwrites 850
INFO dry-run end: checksum delta 0.0002
```

josh.l: Checksum delta looks negligible. Next: run a 24h canary with dedupe and upsert-mode=last_write_wins. @marta can you book 02:00-03:30 UTC maintenance?

marta: I can carve 02:00-03:30 UTC. Prefer we run with reduced concurrency and enforce backpressure on reporting reads.

priya.r: Note on idempotency: worker writes last_seen_timestamp per key. Overlapping runs are safe if --dedupe-window is set; it ensures monotonic last_seen.

anna.k: Owners: mike -> run canary and validate; josh -> review upsert transaction for race conditions; priya -> add dashboard panels for overwrite rate + checksum delta; marta -> confirm maintenance window and set DAG concurrency.

mike.h: Starting canary with flags: --dedupe-window=3600 --upsert-mode=last_write_wins --shard=eu-west-1 --start=2026-03-24T00:00 --end=2026-03-25T00:00

analytics-bot: canary progress: 25% processed

anna.k: Two follow-ups: 1) rough cost estimate for full EU rerun (worker-hours, IO) 2) rollback plan if recompute outputs look bad after promotion

josh.l: Cost estimate: ~40 worker-hours and ~1.2TB IO for a month of EU data. Rollback: keep hourly_agg_v2 backup table; promotion is atomic rename if checksum under threshold (0.5%). If threshold exceeded, abort promotion and keep v2.

marta: Add a short-lived alert: if overwrite_rate > 70% for >10m during promotion, auto-fail and revert.

mike.h: Canary finished — results: 900 upserts, 700 overwrites, checksum delta 0.0001. Pushing metrics to telemetry-ops dashboard.

analytics-bot: posted grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/d/telemetry/recompute-canary?orgId=1

anna.k: If canary is green, schedule full EU rerun for 02:00 UTC tomorrow with max_active_tasks=4, dedupe-window=3600, and rollback guards. I'll post a deploy checklist in this thread.

josh.l: Add a preflight task that runs the distinct-keys SQL and captures a baseline; include preflight_check + postflight_checksum + promote_if_pass in DAG.

priya.r: Added preflight and postflight tasks in DAG PR. promote_if_pass will only run when checksum delta < 0.5% and overwrite_rate < 70%.

marta: Maintenance window confirmed 02:00-03:30 UTC. Ops oncall is tagged.

anna.k: Great. I'll open the run ticket and close this thread once the rerun completes. :thumbsup:
